title: Sample 12: Prohibited Street Slang & Unapproved Greeting
notes: Recorded without provider credentials: gates, citation verifier, consensus and scoring ran for real; the two LLM reviewers were not called, so soft-category findings (tone, messaging) are absent.

post.caption: Yo bro, sasta and chindi collections are out, curated vintage is in! Happy Festivities from Thrift-It. #ThriftIt

findings.clauseQuote: Informal street slang that detracts from a curated, premium experience is banned, including: "chindi", "kachra", "ghanta", "faltu", "bakwaas", "chapri", "sasta", "loot lo", and "bhasad"
findings.explanation: Prohibited slang term detected. Use respectful, curated Hinglish expressions.
